protocol.claimScope: Relative comparison of Cuckoo writing/retrieval strategies; not absolute benefit over no memory, natural cadence, or general coding performance.
protocol.unit: Final artifact from a native continuation; retrieval siblings share a frozen prefix. Repetitions are not provider RNG seeds. Task/parameter checks are not independent samples.
protocol.contextReduction: Deterministic native compaction retaining a neutral anchor; all source records and saved reports remain tool-accessible.
protocol.retrieval: Literal-word search over the exact same saved branch report set; never source documents or evaluator answers. Tie-break newest-first. Baseline list/read remains available.
protocol.primary: Strict final artifact correctness and perfect-artifact rate; include every planned continuation in accounting. Execution failures separate from semantic failures.

independentAudit.scope: Two blinded read-only audits of public outputs against visible contracts; no private thinking; content may reveal strategy. Per-check projections are not independent fault diagnoses.

componentCheckInterpretation: Frozen schema-gated projections, not independent causal or privacy diagnoses. Primary perfect requires every clause; manually audited primary labels agree.
privacy: No private configuration, credentials, raw session history or thinking blocks. Public text remains in local audited artifacts.
